name: caption-emoji
title: Caption Emoji
description: An emoji pops up above a chosen word the moment it is spoken and stays until the phrase leaves.
useWhen: Short-form social video where a few words deserve a visual punchline: an emoji lands on the beat the word is said.
You want playful emphasis that adds to the text instead of restyling it, so the caption stays readable.
avoidWhen: The video is a calm explainer or a product walkthrough: use caption-subtitle.
You want the spoken word itself to stand out rather than an add-on above it: use caption-active-pop.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Captions
variables.description: Word timings as JSON: [{"text","startMs","endMs"}] in milliseconds, or [{"text","start","end"}] in seconds. A transcript from Mosio works as is.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Caption text size in pixels (at 1080 px on the short side).

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words that start within this window share one page of captions. A sentence end always starts a new page.

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: How long the last page stays after its final word.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Soft shadow behind the text for legibility on footage.

variables.label: Emoji
variables.description: JSON object mapping a spoken word to its emoji, for example {"fire":"🔥"}.

variables.label: Emoji size
variables.description: Emoji size in em, relative to the caption text.
